failure.authenticationAgentEmpty.problem.defaultMessage: Your SSH agent holds no keys, so ssh had no key to offer {name}.
failure.authenticationAgentEmpty.problem.description: What went wrong when a connection failed.

failure.authenticationAgentEmpty.remedy.defaultMessage: Add your key with ssh-add, then connect again.
failure.authenticationAgentEmpty.remedy.description: How to fix a failed connection.

failure.authenticationCertificateExpired.defaultMessage: Your SSH certificate has expired, so {name} refused it.

failure.authenticationCertificateExpired.description: How to fix a failed connection.

failure.authenticationKeyRejected.proble.description: What went wrong when a connection failed.

shell.noSession.description: Shown in the terminal area while no session is open.

sidebar.badAddress.defaultMessage: Not a host address. Type an SSH alias, or user@host:port.
sidebar.badAddress.description: Error shown when the typed host cannot be used.

sidebar.empty.description: Shown in the hosts area before any host is added.

sidebar.hosts.description: Heading of the sidebar area that lists known hosts.

sidebar.noSessions.description: Shown in the sessions area while no session is open.

sidebar.sessions.description: Heading of the sidebar area that lists open sessions.

sidebar.toggle.description: Button that shows or hides the sidebar when the window is narrow.
